comment: Boxes are the ink boxes on the first train/good crop, in px from the film's top-left corner. 'blocks' run left to right and form the chain left edge -> block -> gap -> ... -> right edge; 'free_blocks' are only measured to the left and top edges. Tolerances in mm on the label plane (camera/calibration.json). No date block: the film is often cut through the date on good labels.
